run_image_caption_retrieval: run image caption retrieval evaluation on COCO dataset using trained embeddings
load_coco_data: load COCO dataset pickle files for train, dev, and test splits from a given path
prepare_sentence_embeddings: prepare sentence embeddings for all COCO captions across train, dev, and test splits
compute_image_text_embeddings: compute image and text embeddings for image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval ranking
evaluate_retrieval_ranking: evaluate image-caption retrieval ranking with recall@1, recall@5, recall@10, and median rank scores
